_comment: Multi-step registration flows. Edited via /admin/registration/flows; rendered on landing pages by the 'registration-flow' section (pick a flow in the Page Builder). Field types: text, email, phone, number, textarea, select, choice (button group), yesno, file, computed (a live display-only price. When 'priced': true it is calculated SERVER-SIDE from the private pricing config (functions/api/_pricing-config.json, edited in the admin Pricing tab): names a 'selfField' and 'publisherField' number field, and offer = (payoutRatePct/100) × (selfRecovery × self + publisherRecovery × publisher). Supports prefix/suffix and gateOn to hide until a field is filled), works-summary (display-only list of works read from an uploaded claim form). A file field may carry 'extract' (a server extractor name, e.g. 'bartz-claim') plus 'extractMap' ({ flowFieldId: 'path.into.result' }) — on upload the file is POSTed to /api/extract-claim and the named fields auto-fill. A step with showIf only appears when the named earlier field equals the given value. Submissions POST to /api/register → notification email (+ Google Sheet, + Attio when ATTIO_API_KEY is configured, labeled with attioLabel).
